name: Russian Twist
steps: Sit with your knees bent, heels on the floor and hands clasped in front of your chest.
Lean back from the hips until you feel your abdominals engage while your back stays long.
Rotate your rib cage and shoulders smoothly to one side to reach your hands toward the floor beside your hip.
Twist smoothly back through center to the opposite hip, alternating sides on each repetition.
tips: Turn your chest and shoulders with your hands rather than merely swinging your arms from side to side.
Keep your feet still as you turn your rib cage.
